versions.changelog:
- Initial release of playwright-stealth-verify (v1.0.0).
- Allows verifying if Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or CDP-driven browsers present a coherent fingerprint using liarjs.
- Works directly with an existing Page object (via checkPage) or by connecting to an external browser via CDP.
- Reports detailed checks on automation indicators (e.g., navigator.webdriver, headless UA tokens, worker/main thread consistency, API patch integrity, GPU mismatch).
- Supports offline testing and customizable endpoints for network fingerprint analysis.
- No runtime dependencies; designed for Node 22+ and integrates with existing test setups without modifying the browser.
